description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Darius''' becomes [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] for 1 second and hefts his axe for 0.75 seconds, afterward swinging it around himself to deal physical damage to nearby enemies. Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.
description.text: Active: Darius becomes ghosted for 1 second and hefts his axe for 0.75 seconds, afterward swinging it around himself to deal physical damage to nearby enemies. Enemies within the inner radius take 35% damage.

description2.raw: Against champions and large monsters hit, '''Darius''' [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] for [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 17% – 51% (based on number of targets hit by the outer radius) of his '''missing''' health. Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of ''[[File:Darius Hemorrhage.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Hemorrhage|An icon for Darius's ability Hemorrhage]] [[Darius#Hemorrhage|Hemorrhage]]''.
description2.text: Against champions and large monsters hit, Darius heals for  17% – 51% (based on number of targets hit by the outer radius) of his missing health. Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of Hemorrhage.

description3.raw: '''''Darius''' can move during Decimate, but is unable to declare basic attacks or cast [[File:Darius Apprehend.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Apprehend|An icon for Darius's ability Apprehend]] [[Darius#Apprehend|Apprehend]] or [[File:Darius Noxian Guillotine.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Noxian Guillotine|An icon for Darius's ability Noxian Guillotine]] [[Darius#Noxian Guillotine|Noxian Guillotine]].''
description3.text: Darius can move during Decimate, but is unable to declare basic attacks or cast Apprehend or Noxian Guillotine.

notes.raw: * ''Decimate'' will cancel if '''Darius''' enters [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]] or uses [[File:Dash.png|20xpx|border|link=Mark#Dash|An icon representing Mark#Dash]] [[Mark#Dash|Dash]] during the delay. ** After the delay, ''Decimate'' will be placed on a 1-second cooldown.
